layer.capability: Evaluate finite natural-radial polynomial prefixes and radial-average prefixes of formal sparse mixed-scale coefficient rows while preserving every channel.
factories: formal_axis_profile_prefix(solver, max_n, Y, eta, radial_order=0, eta_order=0)

prefix_maps.rows: finite rows 0..max_n from one eta-local family graph

validation.scope: bounded compile and one small Y=0 prefix smoke

layer.remaining_boundary: The finite prefix leaves an unknown radial tail and does not prove global weighted AxisSpace membership, fixed-point convergence, paper-exact velocity, forcing, or a physical-coordinate theorem profile. Decimal96 rounding is not exact real or interval arithmetic.

forbidden_inferences: a finite prefix is a converged or fixed-point profile
retained rows imply a tail or truncation bound
formal sparse channel maps imply omitted physical channels are zero
a signed-log view evaluates the amplitude or Lambda powers
a small polynomial smoke proves the natural-axis theorem
Decimal96 rounded arithmetic is exact real arithmetic or a certification
